title: Airtable Business to self-hosted Baserow
summary: At ten seats Airtable Business is $5,400 a year. That is enough that the arithmetic stops being interesting and starts being obvious.

you_lose: Airtable's automations, scripting and the extension marketplace
Enterprise controls that Baserow gates behind its own paid tier
you_gain: Postgres underneath, queryable by anything you own
Free seats at a tier where Airtable charges $45 each

caveats: Baserow's advanced and enterprise features are separately licensed. The comparison here is against the free core; check the feature matrix if you need row colouring, audit logs or SSO.
Twelve hours assumes a handful of bases. A decade of accumulated Airtable across a company is a much bigger job.
